scope: RGB-only box annotation consistency and frozen-DINO small localization feasibility; not downstream relations or formal independent test
selection: official8episodes: frame-sorted indices7 and22 of30; four named historical C/D roots: middle existing record, all chosen before viewing images this round
split: A/B official source episodes disjoint4train4development; C/D historical roots only viewed diagnostic. All source sets already seen in prior work, no independent-test claim

annotation.drawer_front: visible movable drawer front panel INCLUDING attached pull handle, EXCLUDING cavity floor/interior, side panels, cabinet face/doors; box tight to visible front-panel-plus-handle extent; no hidden/amodal completion
annotation.gripper_finger: one box per visibly identifiable mechanical finger distal to main palm (up to2); include finger body/tip, exclude palm/wrist/arm and held object; same unordered class, no physical left/right ID
annotation.unknown: no box when cannot identify/bound visible target; ignore uncertain class-image in training/scoring, report its prediction rate separately
annotation.coordinates: integer RGB xyxy pixels, exclusive upper bounds; drawn after actually viewing RGB only
annotation.annotator: assistant visual annotation, reviewed overlays, not independent human gold standard

quality_gate.failure: stop before training if unresolvable ambiguity or any gate fails; no threshold relaxation

encoder: cached frozen DINOv2-small fullRGB resized224,16x16x384. no robot or simulator fields; train-only feature normalization; no new model download
baseline: shared pointwise384->64SiLU->10 outputs2class center logits+4box values perclass; no explicit XY/camera/scene input; same weight across patches, no fixed ROI
loss: binary focal alpha.25 gamma2 normalized by positive centers perimage plus5 smoothL1 mean of center offsets & normalized widthheight plus2 mean GIoU loss at positives; uncertain class entirely ignored
optimizer: AdamW lr.001 wd.0001 clip1, two fixed seeds, final600 only
sampling: random permutations of16training images, batch8,300epochs, no augmentation
decode: 3x3 local maxima,score>=.5,class-wise NMS IoU.3,max1drawer_front/max2finger; no fallback if absent
evaluation: IoU>=.5 greedy one-to-one; TP/FP/FN, precision/recall, perGT best IoU with no detection=0, localization coverage; known not_visible FP and uncertain prediction rates; split/scene/camera/category/visibility strata; no tuning
relation_stage: not run in this bounded round even if localization looks promising
